summary: Full backend + frontend test of cGreen landing page. All 4 backend pytest tests pass (health, create+list contact, invalid email 422, missing fields 422). Frontend at 1440x900: all 11 required sections render, navbar dropdowns work (About Us shows 3 items, Services shows Platform/Pragati Kendra/Lending Institution), nav-login opens https://tx.cgreen.in/Login in new tab, Book a Demo / Our Solution / Contact Us anchors scroll correctly. Services tab switches when clicking Lending Institution dropdown (Lending gets glass-yellow active, Pragati becomes glass-navy inactive). Pragati is default active on load. Count-up stats reach 10+, 4, 35, 957K+. solution-logo present after scroll into #solution. Contact form: empty submit shows inline field errors (blocks POST), invalid email blocks, unchecked terms blocks, filled valid form + terms POSTs to /api/contact and displays 'Thanks! Your message has been received' success toast; form resets (first name empty after submit). Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 90 uses `logger` before it is defined (logger = getLogger at line 114). Works because it's inside an async function invoked at runtime after module load, but is fragile; move logger setup above the routes.
GET /api/contact returns all submissions with no pagination or auth — acceptable for stub but should be gated before production.
Contact form POST is a MOCKED CRM stub (per spec, FLAGGED-UNDECIDED). Data persists to MongoDB collection contact_submissions only.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ prefixed contact submissions in MongoDB via API tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Frontend tested only at desktop >=1024px (design intent). Contact form is stub—no CRM. Nav dropdown data-testids follow slug pattern: nav-drop-pragati-kendra, nav-drop-lending-institution, nav-drop-platform, nav-drop-about-cgreen, nav-drop-our-teams, nav-drop-partners-in-impact.
